map.盈利指数计算器。输入现值收益与初始投资，求单位投资带来的现值收益，用于互斥项目的: Profitability index calculator. Enter the present value of returns and the initial investment to get the present value brought per unit of investment, used to rank capital-budget alternatives.
map.单位投资带来的现值收益。: The present value return brought by each unit of investment.
map.由未来现金流现值除以初始投资得 PI，>1 才可行。: PI = present value of future cash flows / initial investment; only above 1 is it feasible.
map.和 NPV 互补，PI 看单位投入的现值回报。: Complements NPV; PI looks at the present value return per unit of investment.
map.在资金受限时比较互斥项目的单位投资产出效率。: Compare the output per unit investment of mutually exclusive projects when capital is limited.
map.：未来现金流现值 = 300/1.1+400/1.21+500/1.331 ≈: Present value of future cash flows = 300/1.1 + 400/1.21 + 500/1.331 = about 979, so PI = 979/1000 = 0.979 < 1, meaning it is marginally infeasible at 10% (consistent with NPV of about -21). If the present value reached 1200 then PI = 1.2 and it would be feasible.
map.现金流 −1000、500、500、500，贴现率 10%: Cash flows -1000, 500, 500, 500 at a 10% discount rate
map.：先把第 1~3 期折现求和：500/1.1+500/1.21+500/1.33: Discount and sum years 1-3 first: 500/1.1 + 500/1.21 + 500/1.331 = about 1243.43 CNY; PI = 1243.43/1000 = about 1.243, that is about 1.243 CNY of present value per 1 CNY invested.
map.由名义收益率与通胀率求实际收益率: Real Return from Nominal Return and Inflation
map.由股利支付率求留存收益率: Retention ratio from the dividend payout ratio
map.PI 和 NPV 关系？: What's the Relation Between PI and NPV?
map.PI>1 等价于 NPV>0；PI 是相对指标便于不同规模项目比效率，NPV 是: PI > 1 is equivalent to NPV > 0; PI is a relative indicator that makes it easy to compare efficiency across projects of different sizes, while NPV is absolute added value and looks at total worth.
map.对单个独立项目完全等价：PI=未来现金流现值÷初始投资，PI>1 即 NPV>0: For a single independent project they are fully equivalent: PI = present value of future cash flows / initial investment, and PI > 1 means NPV > 0. In the earlier example the initial investment is 1000 CNY and the present value is 1243.43 CNY, giving NPV of about 243.43 CNY. But when ranking mutually exclusive projects under capital constraints, PI ranks by efficiency and NPV by absolute value added, so the two can select different projects.
